name: @nirholas/free-crypto-news-mcp

tools.name: get_latest_news
tools.description: Latest crypto headlines from 300+ sources (CoinDesk, The Block, Decrypt, Bloomberg, Reuters and more). Filter by category or source, sort by AI impact score, or restrict to the curated tier-1 homepage feed.

source.description: Source id, e.g. coindesk, theblock, decrypt, cointelegraph

homepage_only.description: Only the curated tier-1/tier-2 sources shown on the homepage

lang.description: ISO-639-1 language code for translated headlines

tools.name: get_breaking_news
tools.description: Breaking crypto news from the last few hours, ranked by urgency. Use for "what just happened" questions.

tools.name: search_news
tools.description: Full-text search across every indexed article. Pass a topic, coin, company or event. Set semantic=true for embedding-based search that matches meaning rather than exact words.

type.description: Search news articles, coins, or both

semantic.description: Use semantic (embedding) search instead of keyword matching

tools.name: get_article
tools.description: Fetch one article. Give an archive id or slug to read it from the archive, or give any article URL to extract its full text and metadata from the publisher page.

annotations.title: Article by id, slug or URL

tools.name: get_archive
tools.description: Query the historical news archive by date range, ticker, source, sentiment or keyword. Every article carries market context (price at publish time).

query.description: Keyword filter on title and description

tools.name: get_archive_stats
tools.description: Coverage statistics for the historical archive: article counts, date range, sources and categories.

tools.name: get_regulatory_news
tools.description: Regulatory and legal developments: SEC, CFTC, MiCA, court rulings, enforcement. Filter by jurisdiction, agency, sector or lookback window, or ask for jurisdiction profiles, agencies, deadlines or an intelligence summary.

jurisdiction.description: Jurisdiction filter, e.g. US, EU, UK, HK

agency.description: Agency filter, e.g. SEC, CFTC, ESMA

sector.description: Sector filter, e.g. exchanges, stablecoins, defi

tools.name: get_portfolio_news
tools.description: News for a specific set of holdings, optionally with live prices for each coin. Use when the user names the coins they hold.

coins.description: Comma-separated coin symbols or names, e.g. "btc,eth,sol"

limit.description: Maximum articles per coin to return (1-50)

prices.description: Attach current price, 24h change and market cap

tools.name: get_daily_digest
tools.description: A compiled digest of the most important stories over the last 6, 12 or 24 hours, in full, brief or newsletter form.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Every news category the API understands, with article counts. Use the ids as the category argument of get_latest_news.

tools.name: get_trending_topics
tools.description: Topics trending across the news flow right now, each tagged bullish, bearish or neutral with sample headlines.

tools.name: get_narratives
tools.description: The narratives currently driving coverage (e.g. RWA, restaking, ETF flows) with momentum, sentiment and related tickers. emerging=true surfaces narratives that are just starting to pick up.

tools.name: get_sentiment
tools.description: AI sentiment for one asset or the whole market: score, confidence, and the headlines that drove it.

asset.description: Asset symbol, e.g. BTC, ETH, SOL. Omit for the market as a whole

tools.name: analyze_news
tools.description: Recent articles with topic classification and sentiment labels, filterable by topic or sentiment. Good for "show me bearish regulation stories".

topic.description: Topic filter, e.g. Bitcoin, Ethereum, DeFi, Regulation, Exchange

tools.name: get_trading_signals
tools.description: News-derived trading signals with direction, confidence and the evidence behind each. Filter by ticker or minimum confidence.

tools.name: get_social_sentiment
tools.description: Aggregate social-media sentiment (X, Reddit, Telegram) across the market.

tools.name: get_fear_greed
tools.description: Crypto Fear & Greed Index (0 = extreme fear, 100 = extreme greed) with daily history.

tools.name: get_market_overview
tools.description: Total market cap, 24h volume, BTC/ETH dominance, active coins and market-cap change.

tools.name: get_coin_prices
tools.description: Live USD prices with 24h change for any list of CoinGecko coin ids.

tools.name: get_top_coins
tools.description: Ranked coin table: price, market cap, volume, supply, 24h/7d change. Up to 250 coins.

tools.name: get_coin_detail
tools.description: Detailed market data for one coin: price, market cap, volume, supply, ATH, 24h/7d/30d change.

tools.name: compare_coins
tools.description: Side-by-side comparison of 2 to 25 coins: price, market cap, volume, performance.

tools.name: get_ohlc
tools.description: Open/high/low/close candles for one coin over 1 to 365 days.

tools.name: get_price_chart
tools.description: Price, market cap and volume time series for one coin over a named range (1h to all-time).

tools.name: get_top_gainers
tools.description: Best-performing coins over 1h, 24h or 7d.

tools.name: get_top_losers
tools.description: Worst-performing coins over 1h, 24h or 7d.

tools.name: search_coins
tools.description: Resolve a name, symbol or partial string to CoinGecko coin ids. Use before price or chart tools when you only know a ticker.

tools.name: get_market_dominance
tools.description: Market-cap dominance split across BTC, ETH, stablecoins and the rest.

tools.name: get_defi_overview
tools.description: DeFi total value locked summary: overall TVL, top protocols and chains, 24h/7d changes.

tools.name: get_defi_yields
tools.description: Yield opportunities with APY, TVL, chain and project. Filter by chain, project, APY band, minimum TVL or stablecoin-only pools.

chain.description: Chain filter, e.g. ethereum, arbitrum, solana, base

max_apy.description: Maximum APY percent (screens out obvious traps)

tools.name: get_stablecoins
tools.description: Stablecoin market caps, peg status and 24h/7d supply changes, optionally broken down by chain.

tools.name: get_dex_volumes
tools.description: Decentralised exchange trading volumes by protocol, optionally for one chain.

chain.description: Chain filter, e.g. ethereum, solana, base

tools.name: get_layer2_data
tools.description: TVL, activity and stats for Ethereum layer 2 networks (Arbitrum, Base, Optimism, zkSync and more).

tools.name: get_gas_prices
tools.description: Current Ethereum gas prices (slow/standard/fast in gwei), base fee and congestion.

tools.name: get_funding_rates
tools.description: Perpetual futures funding rates across Binance, Bybit, OKX and Hyperliquid, with cross-exchange spreads. Positive means longs pay shorts.

min_spread.description: Only pairs whose cross-exchange spread exceeds this (percent)

tools.name: get_liquidations
tools.description: Recent forced liquidations across exchanges: totals, long/short split and largest events.

tools.name: get_derivatives
tools.description: Perpetual and futures tickers: open interest, volume, funding and basis across major venues.

tools.name: get_options_data
tools.description: Options market for BTC or ETH: dashboard, flow, volatility surface, max pain or gamma views.

expiry.description: Expiry date YYYY-MM-DD for max pain

tools.name: get_orderbook
tools.description: Order book depth (bids, asks, spread, liquidity) for a pair on one or more exchanges.

tools.name: get_arbitrage
tools.description: Cross-exchange price spreads for a symbol, ranked by spread or estimated profit.

symbol.description: Asset symbol, e.g. BTC, ETH; omit for all tracked assets

tools.name: get_whale_alerts
tools.description: Large on-chain transfers between wallets and exchanges, with USD value and direction, across major chains.

blockchain.description: Chain filter, e.g. bitcoin, ethereum, solana, or all

tools.name: get_exchange_flows
tools.description: Net inflow/outflow of an asset to and from centralised exchanges, a classic accumulation or distribution signal.

tools.name: get_token_unlocks
tools.description: Upcoming token unlock schedules with amounts, USD value and share of circulating supply. calendar=true groups them by date.

project.description: Project or token filter, e.g. arbitrum

tools.name: get_events_calendar
tools.description: Upcoming crypto events: conferences, hard forks, mainnet launches, token unlocks, macro dates.

category.description: Event category, e.g. conference, hardfork, unlock, launch

tools.name: get_airdrops
tools.description: Upcoming, active and ended airdrops with eligibility notes and estimated value.

tools.name: get_exchanges
tools.description: Exchange directory ranked by trust score or volume: 24h volume, trust score, year established, country.

tools.name: list_sources
tools.description: Every news source the aggregator indexes, with ids (usable as the source argument elsewhere), tiers and feed URLs.

tools.name: get_source_health
tools.description: Health of the API and each upstream feed: status, latency, last successful fetch, failing sources.

tools.name: get_macro_indicators
tools.description: Macro backdrop for crypto: rates, CPI, DXY, equities and their correlation with BTC.

tools.name: get_glossary
tools.description: Look up a crypto term or browse a glossary category.

category.description: Category filter, e.g. trading, defi, blockchain

tools.name: summarize_news
tools.description: AI-written summary of the latest articles, optionally for one source, as a brief, detailed prose or bullet points.

tools.name: ask_crypto
tools.description: Ask a natural-language question about crypto news and markets; the answer is grounded in current articles and cites its sources.

question.description: The question, e.g. "Why did ETH move today?"

context.description: Extra context to steer the answer

tools.name: get_ai_brief
tools.description: AI-generated daily market brief: price action, sentiment, key stories and what to watch.

date.description: Brief for a specific date YYYY-MM-DD (default today)

tools.name: get_rss_feeds
tools.description: RSS, Atom and OPML feed URLs for the news categories. Pass fetch=true to return the XML of one feed instead of just its URL.

fetch.description: Download the RSS XML for the chosen feed

limit.description: Maximum items when fetching to return (1-50)

tools.name: list_endpoints
tools.description: Discover the REST API behind these tools: the live OpenAPI path list (optionally filtered) plus the endpoint each MCP tool maps to.

filter.description: Only paths containing this text, e.g. "defi"

tools.name: get_stories
tools.description: The news collapsed into events instead of headlines. One entry per story, with the outlet credited with publishing first and every outlet that followed, including how far behind each was. Use this instead of get_latest_news when the question is "what happened" rather than "what was published", when you need to avoid counting one event forty times, or when you want to know who broke something. Each story carries a confidence level and a plain-English reason; attribution rests on publisher timestamps, and a story whose timing cannot be verified reports originator: null rather than guessing.

limit.description: Maximum articles to analyse to return (1-300)

category.description: Restrict the corpus to one news category

min_outlets.description: Smallest cluster to return. 1 includes exclusives that only one outlet covered

confidence.description: Only stories whose attribution is at least this strong

tools.name: get_story
tools.description: Everything known about a single clustered story: the originating outlet, every outlet that followed in order, the lag for each, and the terms that grouped them as evidence. Story ids come from get_stories and stay stable while a story is in the analysis window; they are not permanent archive identifiers.

annotations.title: One story, with its full propagation chain

tools.name: get_source_leaderboard
tools.description: Ranks news outlets by how often they published first across the current window, with median lag when they followed. Unlike any "top crypto news sites" list, this is measured from publication times over clustered stories rather than from traffic or popularity. Read meta.caveats before quoting it: the window is hours not history, timing comes from publisher feeds which are frequently wrong, and publishing first says nothing about accuracy. An outlet with too little evidence reports a null rate rather than a flattering percentage.

limit.description: Maximum articles to analyse to return (1-300)

category.description: Restrict the corpus to one news category

ranked_only.description: Only outlets with enough evidence for a measurable origination rate

annotations.title: Which outlets break stories, and which follow

tools.name: get_source_feed_health
tools.description: Per-source liveness for the RSS layer: success rate, latency, last error and last successful fetch. A feed that fails is turned into an empty result so one dead source never breaks the aggregate, which also means a source can rot invisibly. Use this to check whether thin coverage of a topic reflects the news or a broken feed.

summary_only.description: Counts only, without the per-source rows

instructions: Free Crypto News: real-time crypto news, market, DeFi, derivatives and on-chain data from cryptocurrency.cv. Tools are read-only and return JSON. Coin ids are CoinGecko ids (bitcoin, ethereum, solana); use search_coins to resolve a ticker. Start with get_latest_news or get_market_overview for broad questions and search_news for specific topics.
